learning_outcomes.text: Identify where AI adds value across the procurement and sourcing cycle
Use AI to assist spend analysis and supplier research with verification
Apply AI to contract and document review while keeping a human in the loop
Recognise bias, data-confidentiality and vendor-lock risks in procurement AI
Keep controls, auditability and fair treatment of suppliers when using AI

integrative_case: A category manager must use AI responsibly to prepare a sourcing event: have AI assist spend analysis and supplier research, verify the findings, review draft contract clauses with AI support, protect confidential bid data, and document the AI use for the sourcing file.
